no: In the plane of a tiangle ABC, let (BC) be the half-plane determined by the line BC that does not include A. Let Ab be the point in (BC) that satisfies \|BAb\| = \|AC\|, and let Ac be the point in (BC) that satisfies \|BAc\| = \|AB\|. Let La be the line of the diagonal points, other than A, of the complete quadrangle BCAbAc. Define Lb and Lc cyclically. Let A' = Lb∩Lc, and define B' and C' cyclically. Then A'B'C' is perspective to ABC, and the perspector is X_39704. (Angerl Montesdeoca, March 20, 2023)
